species.name: Trout
why: Water 53°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 28–40 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 40 ft, cold below.

species.name: Spotted bass
why: Water 53°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 14–34 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 40 ft, cold below.
